name: Mauville City
lines:
That’s the HM for Rock Smash!
Even if there are some big ol’ rocks
blocking the path you want to take,
you can bust ’em in pieces using that HM.
...That’s the HM for Rock Smash!
Even if there are some big ol’ rocks
blocking the path you want to take,
you can bust ’em in pieces using that HM.
...That’s the HM for Rock Smash!
Even if there are some big ol’ rocks
blocking the path—

That fellow there...
He’s been dreaming of giving Rock Smash
to a Trainer like you for a very long time.
He’s been practicing endlessly to deliver
his explanation without a single mistake.

I call on Slakoth about once a week.
Sometimes I just want to see a creature
that’s not about trying so hard all the time...
